anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact regressed: Before refused the course model entirely (no deliver verb, asked a clarifying question on `2`, treated BEHIND as a missing decision, never renewed the window, and in D labelled remote A as `pre_head`), so it failed f1, f2, f3, f5 and f6, while After delivers all six and keeps f4. Two spots in After are only loosely worded and could be tightened so the facts read unambiguously rather than by inference: in the main table the 12:02 row says the 12:17 deadline is minted by the 'first step-4 watch' rather than by the own push itself—state 'own push sets 12:17' to match the renew-only-on-own-push rule you otherwise apply at 12:10 and 12:12; and in Checkpoint C say explicitly that exactly one re-run was requested and is the one being watched (currently only implied by 'no further re-run'). Everything else—persisted course/caps before writes, base-only observation row, sync without a pick, final menu with merge offered but stop chosen, B's base-sync-is-not-source-change exit, D's separate lease (A) and restore (B) heads with reset-to-B and no second push—already lands the Change cleanly.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Before refused the deliver course outright, so it kept none of the facts; After delivers the course model correctly for f1, f3, f4, f5 and f6 but misses f2 because it binds the poll deadline to watch admission rather than to the own push: the 12:02 push shows `null` ("No watch has initialized a deadline") instead of 12:17, and the 12:10 push shows "null at push; 12:25 on first watch admission" instead of 12:25 at push, while only the 12:12 sync push lands on 12:27. The Change text itself says timeout renews only on own push, so the After wording should state that every own push, including repair pushes made before any watch starts, sets `poll_deadline = push time + 15m` (12:02→12:17, 12:10→12:25, 12:12→12:27) and that a watch merely consumes the already-persisted deadline; keep the base-observation row as is since it correctly refuses to renew. A smaller consistency nit: the main-sequence stop says it deletes the run record and gate artifacts yet also "runs no terminal cleanup steps" — phrase it as 'runs no branch deletion, base sync or release overrides' so the retirement of this PR's own files does not read as a contradiction.
